description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

description.zh: 要查询的防护对象，多个防护对象用英文逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The protected objects that you want to query. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,).

title.zh: 查询防护对象日志外发投递状态
